description: This Java class provides centralized configuration utilities for a test automation framework. It reads configuration values from system properties, environment variables, and a .env file, and supplies default values for demo credentials and other settings required during test execution.

classes.name: TestConfig
classes.description: A final utility class that loads configuration settings for testing purposes, prioritizing JVM properties, environment variables, and default values.

methods.name: get
methods.description: A private static helper method that retrieves a configuration value by key, checking system properties, .env file, and environment variables, returning a default if none are set.

methods.name: baseUrl
methods.description: Provides the base URL for the test environment, defaulting to the OrangeHRM demo site.

methods.name: browser
methods.description: Returns the browser type to use during tests, defaulting to Chrome.

methods.name: headless
methods.description: Indicates whether tests should run in headless mode, defaulting to false.

methods.name: chromeBinary
methods.description: Returns an explicit path to the Chrome/Chromium binary, if specified, for use in containerized environments.

methods.name: adminUsername
methods.description: Provides default admin username credentials for demo purposes.

methods.name: adminPassword
methods.description: Provides default admin password credentials for demo purposes.

methods.name: essUsername
methods.description: Provides default ESS user credentials, typically same as admin for demo stability.

methods.name: essPassword
methods.description: Provides default ESS user password credentials.
